tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal chen yang dag gi thig tshon byin rlabs sngags 'chang dgongs gsal bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra he ru kā ya/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i dpal chen yang dag gi dkyil 'khor rdul tshon du bsgrub pa'i tho yig las/ thig tshon byin rlabs ye thig tshon pra brtag pa sogs phur pa bzhin/ zhes gsungs pa kho nar byas kyang 'gal ba cung zad kyang med pa ni/ yang phur gnyis ma rgyud dang / sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi gras su mthun pas/ cho ga bsres pa dang / chad lhag gi skyon du mi 'gyur/ 'on kyang yang dag sgrub dkyil rang gi dgos chos phur pa'i spyi khog phub te nyams su len tshul ni/ tshon sngon po la hūm̐/ dkar por bh+rūṃ/ ser por oṃ/ dmar por dz+rīṃ/ ljang khur khaṃ rnams rdo rje'i rtses bris la dbus dang phyogs bzhir bzhag mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang / rdor dril nang mchod bshams la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ thig tshon mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dbus dang phyogs bzhir pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la/ rang nyid skad cig gis gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ rdo rje hūm̐ gi mtshan pa'i nor bur oṃ/ rtse mor phaṭa kyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma as mtshan par bsam/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ yab yum snyom par sbyor ba'i dga' ba'i sgras sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar rjes su chags pa'i mes 'od du zhu/ yab kyi gsang gnas nas yum gyi mkhar thig le babs hūm̐ bh+rūṃ āṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ lngar gyur pa yum gyi mkha' nang nas gdan stengs su babs te zhu ba las he ru ka rigs lngar gyur pa ni thig tshon badz+ra he ru ka sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/

yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thig tshon dkar po bud+dha he ru ka dkar po dang 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dkar mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs/ thig tshon ser po rat+na he ru ka ser po/ rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs/ thig tshon dmar po pad+ma he ru dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa sogs thig tshon ljang gu karma he ru ka ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang gu gri thod 'dzin pa sogs/ yab yum thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ he ru ka pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ badz+ra a hā ra/ sogs kyis mchod/ rigs lnga 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsi tra ma ti kra la badz+ra sa mā ya hūm̐ āḥ zhes pas tshon dang / oṃ pu tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes pa'i thig byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags gnyis nyer gcig la sogs pa bzlas/ de nas srad bu rnams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam la/ de'i 'od kyis sku gsung thugs kyi lha tshogs spyan drangs/ yig 'bru gsum la thim te 'od du zhu ba las sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ji ltar rigs pa bzlas te/ slob dpon gyis thig skud rnams bsdus/ tshon gyi yi ge rnams mtheb srin g.yon gyi bsubs la sngon po'i rigs rnams la sngon po nas cung zad re bsre/ de bzhin dkar po sogs gzhan rnams la'ang shes par bya'o/ /rang gtso bo dang las kyi rdo rje slob ma bdud rtsi 'khyil pa zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa la thig skud sngon po/

dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu rnams rim pas thig sna gtad de brkyangs la/ 'jig rten khams ni ma lus pa'i/ /sems can rnams kyi don bya'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas ma lus thams cad kun/ /byang chub sems ni gcig tu gyur/ /oṃ a n+yo3n+ya a nu ga tā/ sarba dharmaḥs+pha ra s+pha ra a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥ sarba dharmāḥbadz+ra añdza li/ a d+yān a nu pra biṣ+ṭaḥsarba dharmaḥbadz+ra ban+dha/ zhes brjod cing dang po so so dang / de nas lhan cig bsgrim bas de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad gnyis su med par bsam la rdo rje la dkris te mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi gtor la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod la bzhag go /de nas slob dpon rdor dril 'dzin pas langs la thig skud dkris pa'i rdo rje rang gi lte ba'i thad du bzung / dkyil 'khor gyi nub nas shar la kha bltas/ slob ma rdor dril 'dzin pas shar nas nub tu kha phyogs karmā badz+ra dz+dzaḥ gnyis brjod cing theg sna gtad/ des kyang / dz+dzaḥ gnyis brjod cing thig sna blangs te lte ba'i thad du bzung / slob dpon gyis/ oṃ badz+ra pu tra mā ti kra ma hūm̐/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs/ /'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pa/ /khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar/ /thig skud sgras ni bskul ma 'debs/ /zhes brjod de/ dang por steng nas 'og tu gcus te nam mkha' la gyen du gdab/ de nas sa la phab nas thig chen brgyad dang logs thig rnams btab pas dkyil 'khor du lam gyis byung bar bsams/ de'i tshe thig skud kyi sgras sangs rgyas thams cad bskul te nam mkha'i khams su byon nas byin gyis brlabs par bsams la tshangs thig dang po gdab bo/ /'debs pa'i go rim ni gong du bshad pa ltar slob dpon nub dang / slob ma shar du gnas pas tshangs thig dang po gdab/ de nas nam mkha' dang sa la 'debs tshul tshig brjod pa rnams gong bzhin thams cad du shes par bya'o/ /slob dpon gyis rgyab sprod tshul du slob ma'i rgyab nas bskor te lho dang /

slob mas rgyab sprod tshul du slob dpon gyi rgyab nas bskor te byang du gnas pas tshangs thig gnyis pa gdab/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas shar lho dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas byang shar du gnas pas shar gyi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon gyi slob ma la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas nub byang dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas lho nub tu gnas pas nub kyi logs thig gdab/ slob dpon de nyid dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas byang shar du gnas pas byang gi log thig gdab/ slob dpon gyis slob ma la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor nas shar lho dang / slob mas slob dpon la rgyab 'gros gong bzhin bskor la lho nub tu gnas pas lho'i logs thigs gdab/ slob dpon de nyid dang / slob ma nub byang du phyin la zur thig dang po gdab/ slob dpon lho nub tu phyin/ slob ma byang shar du phyin te zur thig gnyis pa gdab bo/ /de nas slob dpon nub dang / slob ma shar du gnas pas thig skud slob dpon gyis rdo rje la dkris shing bsdus la/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor gnas pas rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ oṃ badz+ra be ga kra ma hoḥzhes brjod pas ye thig nam mkhar btegs nas slob dpon gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su phyin te kha shar la blta bas gzhi bca' pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje snying kha dang dril bu dkur brten te/ hrīḥhrīḥ zhes brjod cing khro bo'i lta bas/ sgo bzhi la shar nas g.yas bskor du bltas pas sgo rnams dbye bar bsam/ sgo bzhi'i thad kyi rtsa thig rnams dri bzang gi chus slob dpon gyi rdor dril bcas bzhin pas srin lag gnyis kyi dri bzang gi chus phyis la/ thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i gegs su gyur pa thams cad dbye bar bya'o/

/zhes brjod cing thig phyi'o/ /ye thig bskor ba bya lugs 'di la dkyil 'khor zhal shar bstan kho na'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ gnas khang sogs dgos byed skabs nas dkyil 'khor zhal lho dang / nub dang / byang rnams la blta dgos byung ba'i tshe/ phyogs dkyil 'khor dang bstun/ mtshams 'jig rten pa dang bstun dgos te/ nag po dkyil chog las/ 'jig rten pa'i dbang ldan du bla ma mi 'gro ba dang / rnal 'byor pa'i phyogs dang 'jig rten pa'i phyogs so sor shes pa gal che'o/ /zhes gsungs pas/ slob ma mer 'gro mi nyan pa'ang shugs bstan gyis shes so/ /des na dkyil 'khor zhal lho dang / nub dang / byang du bstan na/ rnal 'byor pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi shar ni dkyil 'khor zhal gang la bstan pa de yin no/ /de bzhin du lho dang byang yang shes so/ /mtshams ni gong du bshad pa ltar 'jig rten pa mthun pa kho na dgos pa'i phyir ma 'khrul bar gal gnad che bas slob dpon gyur pa rnams kyis rtogs pa zhib la blangs/ tshangs thig gnyis g.yas bskor du dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs dang bstun/ logs thig zur thig gdab lugs dkyil 'khor zhal gang la bstan rung zhal shar bstan bzhin 'jig rten pa'i shar lho nges pa can no/ /slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kha shar du phyogs par 'dug la/ byang shar nas rtsig pa sgo tshad gcig tsam slob dpon gyi lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis bri zhing / hūm̐ 'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /de byung rigs lnga'i ngo bo nyid/ /sems can ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /tshon gyi las 'di bdag gis brtsams/ /oṃ badz+ra tsi tra ma ti kra ma badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐ aḥ zhes brjod cing nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar po rnams cung zad bri/ de nas lag pa g.yas sam/ slob ma gzhan gyis rtsigs pa byings dang sbom phra mthun par bri tshar ba dang / teng zhabs rwa can gyis kha bcad nas zan sogs kyis mi bcug par byas la zhabs ra'i steng du ye thig gi rdo rje tshon skud dkris pa de bzhag

yid kyis me tog la sogs pa mchod pa lnga phul/ dbus kyi phur khung 'og nas rim pa bzhin/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu/ sngon po rnams kyis bkang la/ slob ma la sogs pas dbus nas rim par bris/ rtsig pa sbrel ran pa na ting bsal te sbrel/ mtshan ma'i tshon bkra brtags pa ste rtsig pa gzhan las dma' ba byung na dngos grub mi thob pas ngan/ mtho na dngos grub 'byung bas bzang / yon po dang bkyog po byung na bgegs zhugs pas bar chad kyi rtags yin te ngan/ shin tu dra na bar med pas bzang / rtsig pa chad na dpon slob gnyis ka 'chi bas shin tu ngan/ ma chad na bzang ngo / /ngan pa byung na rtsig pa bshig la lha dang bla ma la gsol ba btab nas gtso bo'i sngags mang du bzlas shing bskyar la 'dri'o/ /bzang na yid kyi mchod pa lnga 'bul/ dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bri cha mngon rtogs bzhin/ mtshan ma ni dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i steng rdo rje sngo bsgrengs che chung gnyis/ phyogs mtshams kyi zla gam rnams su pad nyi'i gdan la lha mo rnams kyi g.yas kyi phyag mtshan/ yang na gtso 'khor rnams kyi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i tshom bu/ dur khrod du'ang phyogs skyong zhing skyong / klu rnams la so so'i mdog dang / grub chen brgyad la tshom bu kha dog gang rung bcas bri tshar ba dang / tshon lhag dang / thig skud la/ puṣ+pe la sogs mchod pa lnga dbul nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dang / badz+ra muḥzhes brjod/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa rang la thim/ zhes ci bder gnas pa'o/ /de nas/ nam mkhar btegs pa'i ye shes kyi thig rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ zhes brjod cing bsams/ zhes yang dag gi thig tshon byin rlabs 'dri tshul dang bcas pa 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos bris// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 kun dga' blo gros/ dpal chen yang dag gi thig tshon byin rlabs sngags 'chang dgongs gsal/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
